# Japan Travel

> > Official Japan tourism guide featuring comprehensive travel information, accommodation directories, regional attractions, and cultural experiences across all prefectures.

Japan Travel (en.japantravel.com) serves as the official English-language tourism portal for Japan, providing travelers with detailed guides to lodging options (ryokan, onsen, hotels), outdoor activities, cultural attractions, festivals, and dining experiences. The site covers destinations from major cities like Tokyo and Nagoya to regional areas including Takayama, Gunma, Tokushima, and Aomori, with specialized content on traditional experiences, museums, and local events.

## Key Topics

- Japan tourism and travel planning
- Accommodation (ryokan, onsen, hotels, capsule hotels)
- Regional destinations (Aichi, Nagoya, Takayama, Gifu, Tokyo, Gunma, Tokushima, Aomori)
- Outdoor activities and recreation
- Cultural attractions and museums
- Traditional hot springs (onsen)
- Japanese festivals and events
- Water sports and mountain activities
- Temple and shrine visits
- Local dining and ramen culture
- Brewery tours
- Handmade crafts and markets
- Historical warriors (Hideyoshi, Kiyomasa)
- Religious art (Enku carvings)

## Essential Pages

- [Japan Travel - Japan Tourism Guide and Travel Map](https://en.japantravel.com): Homepage for Japan's official tourism guide with maps and trip planning
- [Accommodation in Japan](https://en.japantravel.com/accommodation): Main accommodation directory for all Japan lodging types and regions
- [Activities in Japan](https://en.japantravel.com/activity): Main activities directory for outdoor attractions across Japan

## Accommodation Guides

- [Onsen Accommodation in Japan](https://en.japantravel.com/accommodation/onsen): Hot springs lodging guide featuring onsen ryokan across Japan
- [Accommodation in Tokyo](https://en.japantravel.com/accommodation/tokyo-ota-city): Tokyo Ota City accommodation guide with diverse lodging options
- [Accommodation in Takayama](https://en.japantravel.com/accommodation/gifu-takayama): Lodging guide for Takayama, Gifu: ryokan, resorts, capsule hotels
- [Accommodation in Gunma](https://en.japantravel.com/accommodation/gunma): Gunma accommodation directory from traditional ryokan to modern hotels
- [Accommodation in Tokushima](https://en.japantravel.com/accommodation/tokushima): Tokushima lodging options from traditional inns to luxury resorts

## Activities & Outdoor Recreation

- [Water Sports Activities in Japan](https://en.japantravel.com/activity/water-sports): Japan water sports directory for outdoor recreation enthusiasts
- [Activities in Takayama](https://en.japantravel.com/activity/gifu-takayama): Takayama outdoor activities: mountains, camping, parks, sports
- [Outdoors Activities in Aomori](https://en.japantravel.com/activity/outdoors-aomori): Aomori outdoor recreation guide: mountains, camping, national parks

## Aichi & Nagoya Attractions

- [A Hands-on Museum in Nagoya](https://en.japantravel.com/aichi/a-hands-on-museum-in-nagoya/26710): Nagoya City Science Museum & Planetarium interactive exhibits review
- [Arako Kannon Temple](https://en.japantravel.com/aichi/arako-kannon-temple-and-enku-carvings/105): Arako Kannon Temple in Nagoya featuring Enku religious carvings
- [Asahi Brewery in Nagoya](https://en.japantravel.com/aichi/asahi-brewery-in-nagoya/26669): Free Asahi Brewery tour in Nagoya, Aichi prefecture
- [Hideyoshi & Kiyomasa Memorial Museum](https://en.japantravel.com/aichi/hideyoshi-and-kiyomasa-memorial-museum/141): Nagoya museum honoring warriors Hideyoshi and Kiyomasa

## Festivals & Events

- [Inuyama Spring Festival](https://en.japantravel.com/aichi/inuyama-spring-festival/28254): Annual Inuyama Spring Festival in April, Aichi prefecture
- [Nagoya Handmade Marche 2027](https://en.japantravel.com/aichi/nagoya-handmade-marche/71216): Nagoya Handmade Marche 2027: 1100+ booths of handmade crafts in Aichi
- [Nagoya Ramen Festival 2027](https://en.japantravel.com/aichi/nagoya-ramen-festival/69450): Nagoya Ramen Festival 2027 featuring ramen varieties from across Japan

## Dining & Cuisine

- [Kajiken Ramen](https://en.japantravel.com/aichi/kajiken-ramen/36456): Kajiken ramen chain serving Nagoya-style Taiwanese mazesoba
- [Nagoya's Thai Kitchen, Pakuchi](https://en.japantravel.com/aichi/nagoya-s-thai-kitchen-pakuchi/4454): Pakuchi authentic Thai restaurant near Nagoya TV Tower
